title: Power Man and Iron Fist #78 Marvel 1982 El Aguila 3rd App Sabretooth Bronze
conditionDescription: Bright cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned with light edge wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Power Man and Iron Fist #78 (February 1982), Marvel Comics - "El Aguila is back... (he wishes he wasn't!)" Third appearance of Sabretooth. Luke Cage and Iron Fist with El Aguila; Kerry Gammill cover. Columbia ten-speed racer contest banner. 60 cent cover price.

Back cover: LEGO Expert Builder Challenge #8859 Harvester ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned with light edge wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
